title: TNTmark
description: A Minecraft mod that uses waves of TNT for CPU benchmarks.
body:
TNTmark is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1 that benchmarks your CPU using TNT explosions. It spawns increasing waves of TNT, measures your TPS under load, and calculates a score that lets you compare your system's performance with others. Features include multiple runs per wave for accuracy, automatic game rule adjustments, and result files saved with timestamp for easy comparison.

You can run the benchmark with /tntmark start
